d: Arnold talks about inviting a group of Veterans to see the show, still being a Republican, Trump asking for his support in 2016, who he thinks could emerge as the ideal presidential candidate in 2028, his new Christmas movie The Man with the Bag having an emotional ending, filming in NYC with lots of paparazzi around, being named World’s Hottest Grandpa by Woman’s World Magazine, the first movie he shot in New York, working on several sequels to different movies he's been in, and he gifts the audience with tickets to see The Man with the Bag.
